svg.aria-label: Retrieve, view and act on e-invoices
svg.title: Retrieve, view and act on e-invoices
svg.desc: Five actions: receive invoice, view invoice list, select and open invoice, download file, and review and take action. Invoices are received automatically. Users can view saved invoices after access and safety checks, even if ERP delivery is not complete. From the opened invoice, users can download a file or review and take action. Download is optional. The ERP uses Query e-invoices and Retrieve e-invoice for lists, details and file links. The file source sends the selected file through its downloadUrl. Pale green shows customer actions and ERP steps. Pale purple shows getting, checking and processing invoice files. White or light grey shows notes and what is needed before starting. Colours do not show whether a function is ready or built. E marks a problem or pending result. Matching S markers link saved files to the invoice list.

g.text: Retrieve, view and act on e-invoices
Invoices are received automatically. Users can view saved invoices after access and safety checks, even if ERP delivery is not complete.
Invoices are collected even when the customer is not signed in.
BEFORE YOU START · Use the business’s existing setup and permitted sources.
Get and save the invoice file.
Allow users to view or download
Convert the file only if needed.
Send the invoice to the ERP.
Use DTS to convert a file to UBL 2.5 only in Phase 3.
Convert only if the file is not UBL 2.5.
Receiving detail → checks, problems and recovery
S continues at the list request
Choose one invoice from the list.
Or review the invoice. No download needed.
Get file choices and links if needed.
Show the result and any unfinished work.
Check permission. Check that the action is available.
SPEC029 covers decisions, reports and recovery.
Show whether the list is empty,
Opening does not download or accept the
A derived file is made from the invoice.
Faithful copy: a labelled UBL copy
See SPEC029 for decisions and reports.
ERP receipt is separate from accounting, import and buyer
Retrieve e-invoice returns file details and links. The file source sends the file when the ERP uses the selected downloadUrl.

Solid lines: usual steps, requests and results. Dashed lines: optional steps, conditions or exceptions. E: exception (problem or pending result). Matching S markers link saved files to the invoice list.

E · Show the problem or pending result, the reason, the next action and who must act. Keep successful results. Retry only the failed or pending step. If the result is unknown, check what happened before trying again.
The lanes show proposed responsibilities. Implementation support still needs to be confirmed. Shared checks use each country’s rules. The ERP shows file labels and controls its own workflow.
Get, check and process invoice files
Colours group activities. They do not show whether a function is ready or built.
